# Multi Select

Pick several options as chips, with search, "+N more" and an optional create option.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Form Controls · Status: beta
- Import: `import { MultiSelect } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/multi-select

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` (required) | `{ value: string; label: string }[]` |  | The options to pick from. |
| `value / defaultValue` | `string[]` |  | Selected values, controlled or not. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string[]) => void` |  | Called with the new selection. |
| `maxVisibleChips` | `number` | `3` | Chips shown before the rest collapse into "+N more". |
| `onInputChange` | `(text: string) => void` |  | Called as the user types. When set, options are shown as given, so you can fetch them. |
| `onCreate` | `(text: string) => void` |  | Adds a "Create “text”" option when the text matches no option. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Skeleton rows instead of options; "Loading" is announced. |
| `aria-label / aria-labelledby` | `string` |  | Name the field: there is no visible label inside it. |

## Example: Labels with create

```tsx
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { MultiSelect } from '@nexub/react';

const labels = [
  { value: 'bug', label: 'Bug' },
  { value: 'design', label: 'Design' },
  { value: 'docs', label: 'Docs' },
  { value: 'perf', label: 'Performance' },
  { value: 'a11y', label: 'Accessibility' },
  { value: 'security', label: 'Security' },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [options, setOptions] = React.useState(labels);
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState(['bug', 'a11y']);
  return (
    <div className="w-[320px]">
      <MultiSelect
        aria-label="Labels"
        placeholder="Add labels…"
        options={options}
        value={value}
        onValueChange={setValue}
        onCreate={(text) => {
          const v = text.toLowerCase();
          setOptions((o) => [...o, { value: v, label: text }]);
          setValue((s) => [...s, v]);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- `Type`: Filters the options and opens the list.
- `ArrowDown / ArrowUp`: Moves through the options.
- `Enter`: Toggles the highlighted option.
- `Backspace`: In an empty field, removes the last chip.
- `Escape`: Closes the list.
- Options carry `aria-checked`; each chip has a "Remove <label>" button.

Related: [autocomplete](autocomplete.md), [chip](chip.md), [select](select.md)

# Navigation Rail

Navigation for medium-width windows: icons over labels, with an active pill behind the icon.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Navigation · Status: beta
- Import: `import { NavigationRail } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/navigation-rail

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Root header` | `ReactNode` |  | Slot above the items, e.g. a primary action. |
| `Root aria-label` | `string` | `'Main'` | Name of the nav landmark. |
| `Item icon / label` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Icon in the indicator pill; label below. |
| `Item active` | `boolean` |  | Marks the current page (aria-current="page"). |
| `Item asChild` | `boolean` |  | Use your router link as the item; pass it as the only child. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { NavigationRail } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  const glyph = (d: string) => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d={d} /></svg>
  );
  return (
    <NavigationRail.Root aria-label="Workspace" className="h-auto bg-[var(--color-surface-container-low)] rounded-[24px]">
      <NavigationRail.Item href="#" icon={glyph('M3 10l9-7 9 7v10a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6H9v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z')} label="Home" active />
      <NavigationRail.Item href="#" icon={glyph('M3 7a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2 2h8a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v8a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z')} label="Files" />
      <NavigationRail.Item href="#" icon={glyph('M12 15a3 3 0 1 0 0-6 3 3 0 0 0 0 6z')} label="Settings" />
    </NavigationRail.Root>
  );
}
```

Related: [sidebar](sidebar.md), [top-nav](top-nav.md)

# Number Ticker

A number whose digits roll to new values on the spatial spring. The first render never animates.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Data Display · Status: beta
- Import: `import { NumberTicker } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/number-ticker

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (required) | `number \| string \| NumberTickerPart[]` |  | A number (formatted with `format` and `locale`), an already-formatted string, or styled parts. |
| `format` | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` |  | Formatting for a number `value`. |
| `locale` | `string` |  | BCP 47 locale. Defaults to the user's. |
| `aria-live` | `'off' \| 'polite'` | `'off'` | Announce changes to screen readers. Use `polite` only for values the user is waiting on. |
| `countOnView` | `boolean` | `false` | Count up from zeros when the ticker first scrolls into view (3.1). Only for a ticker that starts below the fold; the server HTML and screen readers always get the real value. Off under reduced motion. |

## Example: Formatted number

Each digit is a 0–9 strip; separators and symbols stay still.

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { NumberTicker, Button } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  const [n, setN] = React.useState(12480);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 items-center">
      <NumberTicker value={n} format={{ maximumFractionDigits: 0 }} className="text-title-lg" />
      <Button size="sm" variant="outlined" onClick={() => setN(Math.round(Math.random() * 100000))}>
        Change
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Example: Amount

`Amount animate` uses the ticker and keeps the quieter symbol and minor units.

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Amount, Button } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  const [balance, setBalance] = React.useState(128450.75);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 items-center">
      <Amount value={balance} currency="USD" size="display" animate />
      <Button size="sm" variant="outlined" onClick={() => setBalance(Math.round(Math.random() * 20000000) / 100)}>
        Change
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Example: Count on view

Scroll the preview so the number enters the view; it counts up once.

```tsx
import { NumberTicker } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex h-48 w-full flex-col overflow-y-auto">
      <p className="m-0 shrink-0 pb-64 text-body-md text-[var(--color-on-surface-variant)]">Scroll down</p>
      <NumberTicker value={2000} countOnView className="shrink-0 text-display-sm" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- The full value is read as one string; the rolling digits are hidden from assistive tech.
- Under reduced motion digits change instantly.

Related: [amount](amount.md), [stat-card](stat-card.md)

# Pagination

Page navigation control with prev/next and page number buttons.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Navigation · Status: stable
- Import: `import { Pagination } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/pagination

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` (required) | `number` |  | The currently active page (1-indexed). |
| `totalItems` (required) | `number` |  | Total number of items across all pages. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | `10` | Number of items per page. Used to calculate total page count. |
| `siblingCount` | `number` | `1` | Number of page buttons to show on each side of the current page. |
| `onPageChange` (required) | `(page: number) => void` |  | Callback invoked with the new page number when the user navigates. |
| `showFirstLast` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether to show First and Last page navigation buttons. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables all pagination controls. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Pagination } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  const [page, setPage] = React.useState(3);
  return <Pagination page={page} totalItems={100} pageSize={10} onPageChange={setPage} />;
}
```

## Example: Large dataset

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Pagination } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  const [page, setPage] = React.useState(3);
  return <Pagination page={page} totalItems={500} pageSize={20} siblingCount={2} onPageChange={setPage} />;
}
```

# Popover

Floating content panel anchored to a trigger element.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Overlays · Status: stable
- Import: `import { Popover } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/popover

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Popover.Root` | `compound` |  | Root provider that manages open/close state. |
| `Popover.Trigger` | `compound` |  | Element that toggles the popover on click. |
| `Popover.Content` | `compound` |  | The floating content panel. |
| `Popover.Arrow` | `compound` |  | Optional arrow pointing to the trigger. |
| `Popover.Close` | `compound` |  | Button that closes the popover. |
| `side` | `'top' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'left'` |  | Preferred side of the trigger to render the content. |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` |  | Alignment of the content relative to the trigger. |
| `sideOffset` | `number` |  | Distance in pixels between the trigger and the content. |
| `surface` | `'solid' \| 'glass'` | `'solid'` | Glass material on Popover.Content — see Foundations → Materials. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { Popover, Button, Text } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Popover.Root>
      <Popover.Trigger asChild>
        <Button variant="outline">Open popover</Button>
      </Popover.Trigger>
      <Popover.Content>
        <Text size="body-sm">This is popover content. You can put anything here.</Text>
      </Popover.Content>
    </Popover.Root>
  );
}
```

## Example: With close button

```tsx
import { Popover, Button, Text } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-3 flex-wrap items-center justify-center">
      {(['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'] as const).map((s) => (
        <Popover.Root key={s}>
          <Popover.Trigger asChild>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">{s}</Button>
          </Popover.Trigger>
          <Popover.Content side={s}>
            <Text size="body-sm">Opens {s}</Text>
          </Popover.Content>
        </Popover.Root>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Prompt Input

The composer for a chat: an auto-growing text field with Send, which turns into Stop while a reply streams.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: AI · Status: beta
- Import: `import { PromptInput } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/prompt-input

## When to use

- The message box of a chat or assistant.
- Any free-text prompt that starts a long-running, stoppable generation.

## When not to use

- Ordinary forms: use Textarea, where Enter adds a line.
- Search: use SearchInput.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value / defaultValue / onValueChange` | `string` |  | Controlled or uncontrolled text. Uncontrolled input clears itself after a submit. |
| `onSubmit` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the text on Enter or Send. Not called while empty, disabled or not `idle`. |
| `onStop` | `() => void` |  | Called by Stop, or Escape in the field, while `status="streaming"`. |
| `status` | `'idle' \| 'submitting' \| 'streaming'` | `'idle'` | `streaming` swaps Send for Stop; `submitting` holds Send until the request is accepted. |
| `maxRows` | `number` | `8` | Rows the field grows to before it scrolls. |
| `attachments` | `ReactNode` |  | Rendered above the text, e.g. removable Chips. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Rendered bottom-start, e.g. an attach IconButton or a model picker. |
| `surface` | `'solid' \| 'glass'` | `'solid'` | Glass material for composers floating over content. |
| `label` | `string` | `messages.promptLabel ('Message')` | Accessible name of the text field. |
| `messages` | `Partial<PromptInputMessages>` |  | Local overrides for `promptLabel`, `sendMessage`, `stopGenerating`, `promptHint`. |
| `textareaClassName` | `string` |  | Class for the textarea; `className` goes to the outer container. |

## Example: Default

Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Send stays inert until there is text.

```tsx
import { PromptInput } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-[520px]">
      <PromptInput placeholder="Ask anything" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Example: Attachments and actions

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { PromptInput, Chip, IconButton } from '@nexub/react';
import { Paperclip, Globe } from '@nexub/icons';

export default function Example() {
  const [files, setFiles] = React.useState(['q3-report.pdf', 'pricing.csv']);
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-[520px]">
      <PromptInput
        placeholder="Ask about these files"
        attachments={
          files.length > 0 &&
          files.map((f) => (
            <Chip key={f} onRemove={() => setFiles((all) => all.filter((x) => x !== f))}>
              {f}
            </Chip>
          ))
        }
        actions={
          <>
            <IconButton size="sm" label="Attach files"><Paperclip /></IconButton>
            <IconButton size="sm" label="Search the web"><Globe /></IconButton>
          </>
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Example: Streaming

Send a message: the button turns into Stop for three seconds. Stop or Escape ends it early.

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { type PromptInputStatus, PromptInput } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  const [status, setStatus] = React.useState<PromptInputStatus>('idle');
  const timer = React.useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>(undefined);
  React.useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(timer.current), []);
  const send = () => {
    setStatus('streaming');
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => setStatus('idle'), 3000);
  };
  const stop = () => {
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    setStatus('idle');
  };
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-[520px]">
      <PromptInput placeholder="Ask anything" status={status} onSubmit={send} onStop={stop} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- Roles: textbox (multiline), button (Send / Stop)
- `Enter`: Sends. Ignored while an IME composition is open.
- `Shift + Enter`: New line.
- `Escape`: Stops the reply while streaming.
- Focus stays in the field after sending, so the user can type the next message straight away.
- An empty field keeps Send focusable with `aria-disabled`, rather than removing it from the tab order.
- The field is named by `label` (default "Message") and described by the Enter/Shift+Enter hint.
- Send and Stop are icon buttons with their own names; the swap does not move focus.

Related: [message-bubble](message-bubble.md), [conversation](conversation.md), [textarea](textarea.md)


---

# Radio Card

A radio group where each option is a whole card: title, description and optional icon, one choice.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Form Controls · Status: beta
- Import: `import { RadioCard } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/radio-card

## When to use

- Two to six options that each need a sentence of explanation, like plans or regions.
- A choice important enough to deserve the space.

## When not to use

- Short labels with no description: use RadioGroup.
- More than six options: use Select or Combobox.
- Cards that hold links or buttons: the whole card is the control, so use Card with CardLink.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `RadioCardGroup columns` | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4` | `1` | Grid columns. Collapses to one column on narrow screens. |
| `RadioCardGroup value / defaultValue / onValueChange` | `string` |  | Radix RadioGroup props; the group also takes `disabled`, `name`, `required`. |
| `value` (required) | `string` |  | The option this card selects. |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The card’s accessible name. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | Secondary text, exposed as the accessible description. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading icon. Turns primary when selected. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | Extra content under the description. Keep it non-interactive: the whole card is the control. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables this card only. |

## Example: Plan picker

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { RadioCardGroup, RadioCard } from '@nexub/react';
import { User, Users, Building2 } from '@nexub/icons';

export default function Example() {
  const [plan, setPlan] = React.useState('team');
  return (
    <RadioCardGroup aria-label="Plan" columns={3} value={plan} onValueChange={setPlan} className="w-full">
      <RadioCard value="solo" icon={<User />} title="Solo" description="One seat, core features.">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">$0 / month</span>
      </RadioCard>
      <RadioCard value="team" icon={<Users />} title="Team" description="Up to 20 seats, shared workspaces.">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">$12 / seat</span>
      </RadioCard>
      <RadioCard value="enterprise" icon={<Building2 />} title="Enterprise" description="SSO, audit logs, priority support.">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">Contact sales</span>
      </RadioCard>
    </RadioCardGroup>
  );
}
```

## Example: Columns

Two columns from the sm breakpoint up, one below.

```tsx
import { RadioCardGroup, RadioCard } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <RadioCardGroup aria-label="Billing" columns={2} defaultValue="yearly" className="w-full">
      <RadioCard value="monthly" title="Monthly" description="Billed every month." />
      <RadioCard value="yearly" title="Yearly" description="Two months free." />
    </RadioCardGroup>
  );
}
```

## Example: Disabled

Disable one card, or pass `disabled` to the group to disable all of them.

```tsx
import { RadioCardGroup, RadioCard } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <RadioCardGroup aria-label="Region" columns={2} defaultValue="eu" className="w-full">
      <RadioCard value="eu" title="Europe" description="Frankfurt" />
      <RadioCard value="us" title="United States" description="Virginia" />
      <RadioCard value="ap" title="Asia Pacific" description="Coming soon" disabled />
    </RadioCardGroup>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- Roles: radiogroup, radio (each card)
- `Tab`: Moves focus into the group, to the selected card.
- `Arrow keys`: Move between cards and select.
- `Space`: Selects the focused card.
- The title is the accessible name and the description is the accessible description.
- Give the group an `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

Related: [radio-group](radio-group.md), [checkbox-card](checkbox-card.md), [card](card.md)


---

# Radio Group

Group of mutually exclusive radio inputs.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Form Controls · Status: stable
- Import: `import { RadioGroup } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/radio-group

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `RadioGroup.Root` | `compound` |  | Root provider that manages selection state. |
| `RadioGroup.Item` | `compound` |  | Individual radio option within the group. |
| `value` | `string` |  | The controlled selected value. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` |  | The initial selected value when uncontrolled. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Callback fired when the selection changes. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables all items in the group. |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` |  | Layout orientation of the radio items. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { RadioGroup, Label } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <RadioGroup.Root defaultValue="monthly">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 items-start">
        {['Monthly', 'Yearly', 'Lifetime'].map((opt) => (
          <div key={opt} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RadioGroup.Item value={opt.toLowerCase()} id={`rg-${opt}`} />
            <Label htmlFor={`rg-${opt}`}>{opt}</Label>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </RadioGroup.Root>
  );
}
```

## Example: Horizontal

```tsx
import { RadioGroup, Label } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <RadioGroup.Root defaultValue="monthly" orientation="horizontal">
      <div className="flex gap-4">
        {[{ value: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly' }, { value: 'annual', label: 'Annual' }].map(({ value, label }) => (
          <div key={value} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RadioGroup.Item value={value} id={`rgh-${value}`} />
            <Label htmlFor={`rgh-${value}`}>{label}</Label>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </RadioGroup.Root>
  );
}
```

# Rating

Star rating input, supports controlled and read-only modes.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Interactive · Status: stable

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

| `value` | `number` |  | The controlled rating value. |
| `max` | `number` | `5` | Maximum number of stars. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents user interaction when true. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  | Size of the star icons. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: number) => void` |  | Callback fired when the user selects a new rating. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';

import { Rating } from '@nexub/react';
```

```tsx
      <Rating size="sm" value={4} readOnly />

    </div>

}
```

# Scroll Area

Scrollable container with custom styled scrollbars.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Disclosure · Status: stable
- Import: `import { ScrollArea } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/scroll-area

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'auto' \| 'always' \| 'scroll' \| 'hover'` | `'hover'` | Controls when the scrollbar is visible. "hover" shows it on mouse-over, "scroll" while scrolling, "always" always, "auto" when content overflows. |
| `scrollHideDelay` | `number` | `600` | Milliseconds before the scrollbar hides after the user stops interacting (only applies to types "scroll" and "hover"). |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal' \| 'both'` | `'vertical'` | Which axis(es) to make scrollable. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Additional CSS class names applied to the viewport wrapper. |
| `style` | `React.CSSProperties` |  | Inline styles applied to the viewport wrapper. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { ScrollArea } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <ScrollArea className="h-[200px] w-[280px] border border-[var(--color-outline-variant)] rounded-shape-field p-3">
      {Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => (
        <div key={i} className="py-1 px-0 text-body-sm text-[var(--color-on-surface-variant)]">
          List item {i + 1}
        </div>
      ))}
    </ScrollArea>
  );
}
```

## Example: Horizontal

```tsx
import { ScrollArea } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <ScrollArea orientation="horizontal" className="w-[320px] border border-[var(--color-outline-variant)] rounded-shape-field p-3">
      <div className="flex gap-2 w-max">
        {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => (
          <div
            key={i}
            className="w-[80px] h-[80px] bg-[var(--color-surface-container-low)] rounded-shape-tooltip flex items-center justify-center text-label-sm text-[var(--color-on-surface-variant)] shrink-0"
          >
            Card {i + 1}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </ScrollArea>
  );
}
```

# Select

Accessible dropdown select built on Radix UI. Supports groups and search.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Form Controls · Status: stable
- Import: `import { Select } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/select

## When to use

- Choosing a single option from a list of 5+ items
- When screen space is limited and a dropdown collapses the options
- Selecting a region, country, currency, or other enumerated value
- Filtering or configuring a setting with predefined choices

## When not to use

- Fewer than 5 options — use RadioGroup to keep choices visible
- Searching or typing to find an option — use Combobox instead
- Multi-select — use Combobox or a checkbox list
- Boolean on/off choices — use Switch or Checkbox

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` |  | Controlled selected value. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Callback when value changes. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  | Placeholder when no value selected. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the select. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { Select } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-[220px]">
      <Select.Root>
        <Select.Trigger><Select.Value placeholder="Select an option…" /></Select.Trigger>
        <Select.Content>
          <Select.Item value="option-1">Option 1</Select.Item>
          <Select.Item value="option-2">Option 2</Select.Item>
          <Select.Item value="option-3">Option 3</Select.Item>
        </Select.Content>
      </Select.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Shared Element

Morphs the same element between two states or pages inside a view transition.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Motion · Status: beta
- Import: `import { SharedElement } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/shared-element

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` (required) | `string` |  | Same name on both sides, e.g. `avatar-${id}`. One element per name on screen at a time. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactElement` |  | One element; the name is set on it. |

## Example: List to detail

```tsx
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Avatar, Button, Card, SharedElement, startViewTransition } from '@nexub/react';

const people = [{ id: 'sl', name: 'Sam Lee', role: 'Finance' }, { id: 'ar', name: 'Ana Ruiz', role: 'Design' }];

export default function Example() {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const person = people.find((p) => p.id === open);
  const go = (id: string | null) => startViewTransition(() => setOpen(id));
  return person ? (
    <Card variant="surface" className="flex w-full flex-col items-center gap-3 p-8">
      <SharedElement name={`avatar-${person.id}`}><Avatar size="xl" fallback={person.id.toUpperCase()} /></SharedElement>
      <p className="m-0 text-title-lg">{person.name}</p>
      <Button variant="outlined" onClick={() => go(null)}>Back</Button>
    </Card>
  ) : (
    <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2">
      {people.map((p) => (
        <button key={p.id} type="button" onClick={() => go(p.id)} className="nx-state-layer flex items-center gap-3 rounded-shape-container border border-[var(--color-outline-variant)] p-3 text-start">
          <SharedElement name={`avatar-${p.id}`}><Avatar size="sm" fallback={p.id.toUpperCase()} /></SharedElement>
          <span className="text-body-md">{p.name} · {p.role}</span>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- Visual only: run the change in `startViewTransition()` and move focus to the new view as usual.

Related: [motion-fade](motion-fade.md)


---

# Sheet

Alias for Drawer — slide-in sheet panel.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Overlays · Status: stable
- Import: `import { Sheet } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/sheet

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Sheet.Root` | `compound` |  | Root provider that manages open/close state. Exported from Drawer. |
| `Sheet.Trigger` | `compound` |  | Element that opens the sheet. |
| `Sheet.Portal` | `compound` |  | Portals the overlay and content into the document body. |
| `Sheet.Overlay` | `compound` |  | Dimmed backdrop rendered behind the sheet. |
| `Sheet.Content` | `compound` |  | The sheet panel. Accepts a side prop. |
| `scrollLock` | `'style' \| 'class'` |  | On Sheet.Root. How page scroll is locked while open. `class` adds a class from @nexub/themes/base instead of injecting a <style> tag, so it works under a strict CSP (style-src 'self'). Default `style`. |
| `side` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom'` |  | Edge of the screen from which the sheet slides in. |
| `Sheet.Header` | `compound` |  | Header section of the sheet panel. |
| `Sheet.Footer` | `compound` |  | Footer section of the sheet panel. |
| `Sheet.Title` | `compound` |  | Accessible title for the sheet. |
| `Sheet.Description` | `compound` |  | Supporting description text for the sheet. |
| `Sheet.Close` | `compound` |  | Element that closes the sheet. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button, Sheet, Text } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Open Sheet</Button>
      <Sheet.Root open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <Sheet.Portal>
          <Sheet.Overlay />
          <Sheet.Content side="right">
            <Sheet.Header>
              <Sheet.Title>Notifications</Sheet.Title>
              <Sheet.Description>Your recent activity</Sheet.Description>
            </Sheet.Header>
            <div className="p-4 flex-1">
              <Text size="body-sm" tone="muted">No new notifications.</Text>
            </div>
          </Sheet.Content>
        </Sheet.Portal>
      </Sheet.Root>
    </>
  );
}
```

# Skeleton

| `width` | `string \| number` |  | Width of the skeleton element. |
| `height` | `string \| number` |  | Height of the skeleton element. |
| `animated` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables the shimmer animation. |

## Example: Default

# Sparkline

A tiny trend line with no axes, for stat cards and table cells.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Data Display · Status: beta
- Import: `import { Sparkline } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/sparkline

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `values` (required) | `number[]` |  | The points, oldest first. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible summary, such as "Revenue, last 12 weeks, up 8%". Without it the sparkline is decorative. |
| `color` | `ChartColor` | `1` | Palette colour, 1–8. |
| `area` | `boolean` | `false` | Fill the area under the line. |

## Example: In a stat

```tsx
import { Sparkline } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-end gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--color-outline-variant)] p-4">
      <div>
        <p className="text-label-md text-[var(--color-on-surface-variant)]">Monthly revenue</p>
        <p className="text-title-lg text-[var(--color-on-surface)]">$68,420</p>
      </div>
      <Sparkline area values={[42, 48, 45, 56, 61, 68]} label="Up 62% over six months" color={2} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- The chart is a `figure` named by `title`. The drawing is hidden from assistive tech; a visually hidden table carries every value.
- Colour is never the only cue: the legend and table name each series. Past six series, label directly or group the rest as "Other".

Related: [line-chart](line-chart.md), [stat-card](stat-card.md)

# Streaming Text

Assistant text as it arrives: new chunks fade in, text already shown stays still, and a caret marks the end.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: AI · Status: beta
- Import: `import { StreamingText } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/streaming-text

## When to use

- Any model output rendered token by token.

## When not to use

- Finished text loaded from history: render it as plain text, or with `streaming={false}`.
- Model output as HTML or Markdown HTML: StreamingText renders text only. Parse Markdown to React elements yourself; never inject model HTML.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` (required) | `string` |  | The full text received so far. Append to it; anything that is not an append renders statically. |
| `streaming` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the caret and sets `aria-busy` while more text is expected. |
| `as` | `'div' \| 'p' \| 'span'` | `'div'` | Element to render. |
| `aria-live` | `'off' \| 'polite'` | `'off'` | Opt-in live announcements. Leave off: screen readers would re-read the region on every token. |

## Example: Streaming a reply

Words arrive on a timer. Restart streams the paragraph again.

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { StreamingText, Button } from '@nexub/react';

const STREAM_DEMO_TEXT =
  'Tokens arrive a few characters at a time. Each new chunk fades in while the text before it stays put, so the eye can keep reading.';

export default function Example() {
  const [length, setLength] = React.useState(0);
  const streaming = length < STREAM_DEMO_TEXT.length;
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!streaming) return;
    const id = setTimeout(() => setLength((n) => Math.min(STREAM_DEMO_TEXT.length, n + 6)), 60);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [length, streaming]);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 items-start max-w-[480px]">
      <StreamingText as="p" text={STREAM_DEMO_TEXT.slice(0, length)} streaming={streaming} />
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setLength(0)}>Restart</Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- Not a live region by default. Announce the finished message once instead, e.g. through a polite status or Conversation’s `announce` for whole messages.
- `aria-busy` is true while streaming, so assistive tech can wait for the final text.
- The caret is decorative (`aria-hidden`). With reduced motion, chunks appear without fading and the caret does not blink.
- Only the last three chunks keep their own span, so the DOM stays flat however long the reply gets.

Related: [message-bubble](message-bubble.md), [thinking-indicator](thinking-indicator.md), [conversation](conversation.md)

# Table

Semantic HTML table with styled variants.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Data Display · Status: stable
- Import: `import { Table } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/table

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Table.Root striped` | `boolean` | `false` | Applies alternating row background colours. |
| `Table.Root bordered` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds borders between rows and columns. |
| `Table.Root hoverable` | `boolean` | `false` | Highlights rows on mouse hover. |
| `Table.Root stickyHeader` | `boolean` | `false` | Fixes the table header to the top when scrolling inside a scrollable container. |
| `Table.Head align` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | `'start'` | Text alignment within the header cell. |
| `Table.Cell align` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | `'start'` | Text alignment within the data cell. |
| `Table.Caption side` | `'top' \| 'bottom'` | `'bottom'` | Whether the caption appears above or below the table. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { Table, Badge } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  const rows = [
    { name: 'Alice Brown', status: 'Active', date: 'Jan 15, 2026' },
    { name: 'Bob Carter', status: 'Pending', date: 'Jan 14, 2026' },
    { name: 'Carol Davis', status: 'Inactive', date: 'Jan 10, 2026' },
  ];
  return (
    <Table.Root className="w-full max-w-[480px]">
      <Table.Header>
        <Table.Row>
          <Table.Head>Name</Table.Head>
          <Table.Head>Status</Table.Head>
          <Table.Head>Date</Table.Head>
        </Table.Row>
      </Table.Header>
      <Table.Body>
        {rows.map((r) => (
          <Table.Row key={r.name}>
            <Table.Cell>{r.name}</Table.Cell>
            <Table.Cell><Badge tone={r.status === 'Active' ? 'success' : r.status === 'Pending' ? 'warning' : 'neutral'} size="sm">{r.status}</Badge></Table.Cell>
            <Table.Cell>{r.date}</Table.Cell>
          </Table.Row>
        ))}
      </Table.Body>
    </Table.Root>
  );
}
```

## Example: With caption

```tsx
import { Table, Badge } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  const rows = [
    { name: 'Alice Brown', status: 'Active', date: 'Jan 15, 2026' },
    { name: 'Bob Carter', status: 'Pending', date: 'Jan 14, 2026' },
    { name: 'Carol Davis', status: 'Inactive', date: 'Jan 10, 2026' },
  ];
  return (
    <Table.Root className="w-full max-w-[480px]">
      <Table.Caption>Recent user activity — last 30 days</Table.Caption>
      <Table.Header>
        <Table.Row>
          <Table.Head>Name</Table.Head>
          <Table.Head>Status</Table.Head>
          <Table.Head>Date</Table.Head>
        </Table.Row>
      </Table.Header>
      <Table.Body>
        {rows.map((r) => (
          <Table.Row key={r.name}>
            <Table.Cell>{r.name}</Table.Cell>
            <Table.Cell><Badge variant="soft" tone={r.status === 'Active' ? 'success' : r.status === 'Pending' ? 'warning' : 'neutral'}>{r.status}</Badge></Table.Cell>
            <Table.Cell>{r.date}</Table.Cell>
          </Table.Row>
        ))}
      </Table.Body>
      <Table.Footer>
        <Table.Row>
          <Table.Cell colSpan={3} className="text-[var(--color-on-surface-variant)] text-body-sm">
            Showing {rows.length} of {rows.length} users
          </Table.Cell>
        </Table.Row>
      </Table.Footer>
    </Table.Root>
  );
}
```

# Tabs

Layered content panels switched by tab triggers. Built on Radix UI Tabs.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Navigation · Status: stable
- Import: `import { Tabs } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/tabs

## When to use

- Switching between related views within the same page context
- Organising content that belongs to the same entity
- Reducing visual clutter by hiding secondary content behind tabs
- Horizontal navigation within a bounded section

## When not to use

- Global site navigation — use the sidebar or top nav
- Sequential steps in order — use StepIndicator
- Comparing content side-by-side — keep both views visible
- More than 5–7 tabs — consider a Select or sub-navigation

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultValue` | `string` |  | Initially active tab value (uncontrolled). |
| `value` | `string` |  | Controlled active tab value. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Callback when active tab changes. |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Layout direction of the tab list. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { Tabs } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-[320px]">
      <Tabs.Root defaultValue="tab1">
        <Tabs.List>
          <Tabs.Trigger value="tab1">Overview</Tabs.Trigger>
          <Tabs.Trigger value="tab2">Analytics</Tabs.Trigger>
          <Tabs.Trigger value="tab3">Settings</Tabs.Trigger>
        </Tabs.List>
        <Tabs.Content value="tab1">
          <div className="py-3 px-0 text-[var(--color-on-surface-variant)] text-body-sm">Overview content goes here.</div>
        </Tabs.Content>
        <Tabs.Content value="tab2">
          <div className="py-3 px-0 text-[var(--color-on-surface-variant)] text-body-sm">Analytics content goes here.</div>
        </Tabs.Content>
        <Tabs.Content value="tab3">
          <div className="py-3 px-0 text-[var(--color-on-surface-variant)] text-body-sm">Settings content goes here.</div>
        </Tabs.Content>
      </Tabs.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Thinking Indicator

Shows the assistant is working before the first token arrives: a morphing shape and a shimmering label.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: AI · Status: beta
- Import: `import { ThinkingIndicator } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/thinking-indicator

## When to use

- The gap between sending a prompt and the first token of the reply.
- Tool calls or retrieval steps inside a reply, with a label naming the step.

## When not to use

- Once text is streaming: StreamingText’s caret already shows progress. Replace the indicator, don’t stack them.
- General loading outside AI surfaces: use Spinner or Skeleton.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode \| null` | `messages.thinking ('Thinking')` | Visible text. `null` hides it; "Thinking" is still announced. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Shape and text size. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ thinking: string }>` |  | Local override for the default text. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { ThinkingIndicator } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return <ThinkingIndicator />;
}
```

## Example: Custom label and sizes

Name the step when you know it. `label={null}` keeps only the shape.

```tsx
import { ThinkingIndicator } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 items-start">
      <ThinkingIndicator label="Searching 4 sources" />
      <ThinkingIndicator size="sm" />
      <ThinkingIndicator size="sm" label={null} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- Roles: status
- A polite live region: the label is announced once when it mounts. Changing the label announces the new step.
- Render it only while waiting and remove it when tokens start, so it is not announced again.
- With reduced motion the shape and shimmer are static.

Related: [streaming-text](streaming-text.md), [spinner](spinner.md), [conversation](conversation.md)


---

# Toast

Imperative toast notifications using the toast object. Render <Toaster /> once in your layout.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Feedback · Status: stable
- Import: `import { Toast } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/toast

## When to use

- Confirming a non-blocking action (file saved, message sent)
- Reporting a background event the user should know about
- Providing brief feedback that disappears automatically
- Offering an undo action immediately after a destructive operation

## When not to use

- Critical errors that block the user — use Alert or AlertDialog
- Information the user must read and acknowledge — use Dialog
- Persistent status that should remain visible — use Alert
- Long messages with multiple lines of text

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Toaster expand` | `boolean` | `false` | Always show toasts as a list. By default they collapse into a stack that fans out on hover or focus, which also pauses their timers. |
| `Toaster position` | `'top-start' \| 'top-center' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-center' \| 'bottom-end'` | `'top-end'` | Where the stack sits (5.1). Start and end follow the reading direction; bottom positions stack upward. |
| `Toaster visibleToasts` | `number` | `3` | How many toasts show at once. Older ones are hidden visually but stay in the live region. |
| `toast.success(title, opts?)` (required) | `string` |  | Show a success toast with an optional options object. |
| `toast.error(title, opts?)` (required) | `string` |  | Show an error toast. |
| `toast.warning(title, opts?)` (required) | `string` |  | Show a warning toast. |
| `toast.info(title, opts?)` (required) | `string` |  | Show an info toast. |
| `toast.custom(title, opts?)` (required) | `string` |  | Show a default/custom toast. |
| `toast.undoable(title, opts)` (required) | `UndoableToastOptions` |  | A toast with an Undo action (beta, 1.7.0). Undo calls `opts.onUndo`; any other close (timer, swipe, close button, `toast.dismiss`) calls `opts.onCommit`, exactly once. Returns the toast id. |
| `undoable opts` | `{ onUndo; onCommit?; undoLabel?; description?; duration? }` |  | `undoLabel` defaults to the `undo` message ("Undo"). Commit the change in `onCommit`, not before showing the toast. |
| `opts.description` | `string` |  | Secondary supporting text below the title. |
| `opts.duration` | `number` | `5000` | Time in ms before auto-dismiss. Use Infinity to persist. |
| `opts.action` | `{ label: string; onClick: () => void }` |  | Renders an action button inside the toast. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { Button, toast } from '@nexub/react';

// The docs root layout already renders <Toaster />; a second one doubles every toast.
export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => toast.custom('Changes saved', { description: 'Your profile has been updated.' })}>
      Show toast
    </Button>
  );
}
```

## Example: Variants

```tsx
import { Button, toast } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap items-center justify-center">
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => toast.success('Saved successfully!')}>Success</Button>
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => toast.error('Something went wrong.')}>Error</Button>
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => toast.warning('Review required.')}>Warning</Button>
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => toast.info('New update available.')}>Info</Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Example: With action

```tsx
import { Button, toast } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Button
      variant="outline"
      onClick={() =>
        toast.custom('File deleted', {
          description: 'The file was moved to trash.',
          action: { label: 'Undo', onClick: () => {} },
        })
      }
    >
      Delete with undo
    </Button>
  );
}
```

## Example: Undoable delete

Hide the item right away; delete it for real only when the toast closes without Undo.

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button, toast } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  const [hidden, setHidden] = React.useState(false);
  const remove = () => {
    setHidden(true);
    toast.undoable('Invoice deleted', {
      description: 'INV-2041',
      onUndo: () => setHidden(false),
      onCommit: () => {},
    });
  };
  return hidden ? (
    <Button variant="text" onClick={() => setHidden(false)}>Restore demo</Button>
  ) : (
    <Button variant="outline" tone="danger" onClick={remove}>Delete INV-2041</Button>
  );
}
```

# Toggle Group

Group of toggle buttons where one or many can be active.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Interactive · Status: stable
- Import: `import { ToggleGroup } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/toggle-group

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` (required) | `'single' \| 'multiple'` |  | Controls whether one or multiple items can be active at a time. |
| `value` | `string \| string[]` |  | The controlled active value(s). |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'outline'` |  | Visual style applied to all toggle items in the group. |

## Example: Single

```tsx
import { ToggleGroup } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <ToggleGroup.Root type="single" defaultValue="left">
      <ToggleGroup.Item value="left">Left</ToggleGroup.Item>
      <ToggleGroup.Item value="center">Center</ToggleGroup.Item>
      <ToggleGroup.Item value="right">Right</ToggleGroup.Item>
    </ToggleGroup.Root>
  );
}
```

## Example: Multiple

```tsx
import { ToggleGroup } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <ToggleGroup.Root type="multiple" defaultValue={['bold', 'italic']}>
      <ToggleGroup.Item value="bold">Bold</ToggleGroup.Item>
      <ToggleGroup.Item value="italic">Italic</ToggleGroup.Item>
      <ToggleGroup.Item value="underline">Underline</ToggleGroup.Item>
    </ToggleGroup.Root>
  );
}
```

# Toggle

Pressable toggle button built on Radix UI Toggle.

- Package: `@nexub/react` · Category: Interactive · Status: stable
- Import: `import { Toggle } from '@nexub/react';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/components/toggle

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pressed` | `boolean` |  | The controlled pressed state. |
| `defaultPressed` | `boolean` |  | The initial pressed state when uncontrolled. |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'outline'` |  | Visual style of the toggle button. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  | Size of the toggle button. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables the toggle when true. |

# Tooltip

Floating label that appears on hover. Built on Radix UI Tooltip.

# Bento Grid

A grid of card tiles in mixed sizes. Responds to its own width: 1 column, 2 at 480px, 4 at 768px.

- Package: `@nexub/patterns` · Category: Layout · Status: beta
- Import: `import { BentoGrid } from '@nexub/patterns';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/bento-grid

## When to use

- Overview pages where a few items deserve more room than the rest.

## When not to use

- Lists the user scans in order: dense packing can move tiles out of reading order.
- Equal-weight items: use Grid.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BentoGrid children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | `BentoTile`s. Dense packing back-fills gaps left by large tiles, so visual order can differ from source order. |
| `size` | `'1x1' \| '2x1' \| '1x2' \| '2x2'` | `'1x1'` | Tile span, columns × rows. Two-wide spans apply from 2 columns up. |
| `...Card props` | `CardProps` |  | A tile is a surface Card (`variant` is fixed); `tone`, `surface` and `effect` pass through. |

## Example: Dashboard

```tsx
import { BentoGrid, BentoTile } from '@nexub/patterns';

function BentoStat({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <BentoTile className="flex flex-col justify-between">
      <span className="text-label-md text-[var(--color-on-surface-variant)]">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-title-lg text-[var(--color-on-surface)]">{value}</span>
    </BentoTile>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const bars = ['40%', '65%', '50%', '80%', '72%', '90%', '60%'];
  return (
    <BentoGrid className="w-full">
      <BentoTile size="2x2" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <h3 className="text-title-sm text-[var(--color-on-surface)]">Revenue, last 7 days</h3>
        <div role="img" aria-label={`Bar chart: ${bars.join(', ')}`} className="flex flex-1 items-end gap-2">
          {bars.map((h, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="flex-1 rounded-shape-min bg-[var(--color-primary-container)]" style={{ height: h }} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </BentoTile>
      <BentoStat label="Active users" value="12,480" />
      <BentoStat label="Conversion" value="3.2%" />
      <BentoTile size="2x1" className="flex items-center text-body-md text-[var(--color-on-surface-variant)]">
        3 invoices awaiting approval.
      </BentoTile>
      <BentoStat label="Churn" value="0.8%" />
      <BentoStat label="NPS" value="61" />
    </BentoGrid>
  );
}
```

Related: [card](card.md), [stat-card](stat-card.md)

# Conversation

Chat layout: a scrolling message list that follows new content, with a sticky composer underneath.

- Package: `@nexub/patterns` · Category: AI · Status: beta
- Import: `import { Conversation } from '@nexub/patterns';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/conversation

## When to use

- A full chat or assistant view: messages above, composer below.

## When not to use

- A single question and answer: a PromptInput and a MessageBubble in normal flow are enough.
- Comment threads that don’t follow new content: use ActivityFeed.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | The messages, usually MessageBubbles. |
| `composer` | `ReactNode` |  | Sticky slot under the list, usually a PromptInput. |
| `autoScroll` | `boolean` | `true` | Follow new content while the reader is at the bottom. Scrolling up stops following and shows "Jump to latest". |
| `announce` | `boolean` | `false` | Make the list a polite `role="log"`. Only for whole-message updates: with token streaming it announces every chunk. |
| `messages` | `Partial<ConversationMessages>` |  | Overrides for `jumpToLatest` and `conversation`. |

## Example: Mini chat

Send a message: it shows Thinking, then streams a cited reply. Stop or Escape ends the reply early.

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { type PromptInputStatus, PromptInput, MessageBubble, ThinkingIndicator, StreamingText, Citation, type CitationSource } from '@nexub/react';
import { Conversation } from '@nexub/patterns';

const CITATION_SOURCES: CitationSource[] = [
  { title: 'Choosing a heat pump', url: 'https://example.com/guides/heat-pumps', snippet: 'Air-source pumps suit most homes with a garden or outside wall.' },
  { title: 'Grants for home heating', url: 'https://example.org/grants', domain: 'example.org' },
  { title: 'Running costs compared', url: 'https://example.net/costs' },
];

type ChatMessage = { id: number; from: 'user' | 'assistant'; text: string };

const CHAT_REPLY = 'Air-source heat pumps work in most homes and run at roughly the cost of gas.';

const CHAT_SOURCE = CITATION_SOURCES[0]!;

export default function Example() {
  const [messages, setMessages] = React.useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [status, setStatus] = React.useState<PromptInputStatus>('idle');
  const timer = React.useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>(undefined);
  React.useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(timer.current), []);

  function send(text: string) {
    const id = Date.now();
    setMessages((m) => [...m, { id, from: 'user', text }, { id: id + 1, from: 'assistant', text: '' }]);
    setStatus('submitting');
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setStatus('streaming');
      stream(id + 1, 0);
    }, 800);
  }

  function stream(id: number, length: number) {
    setMessages((m) => m.map((msg) => (msg.id === id ? { ...msg, text: CHAT_REPLY.slice(0, length) } : msg)));
    if (length >= CHAT_REPLY.length) return setStatus('idle');
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => stream(id, length + 4), 50);
  }

  function stop() {
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    setStatus('idle');
  }

  const last = messages[messages.length - 1];

  return (
    <Conversation
      className="h-[420px] w-full"
      composer={<PromptInput placeholder="Ask about heat pumps" status={status} onSubmit={send} onStop={stop} />}
    >
      {messages.map((msg) =>
        msg.from === 'user' ? (
          <MessageBubble key={msg.id} from="user">{msg.text}</MessageBubble>
        ) : (
          <MessageBubble key={msg.id} from="assistant">
            {status === 'submitting' && msg === last ? (
              <ThinkingIndicator />
            ) : (
              <>
                <StreamingText as="span" text={msg.text} streaming={status === 'streaming' && msg === last} />
                {msg.text === CHAT_REPLY && <Citation index={1} source={CHAT_SOURCE} />}
              </>
            )}
          </MessageBubble>
        ),
      )}
    </Conversation>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- Roles: region (default) or log (with `announce`)
- `Tab`: The message list is focusable so keyboard users can scroll it.
- Keep focus in the composer while a reply streams; don’t move it to the new message.
- The list is named "Conversation". Leave `announce` off while streaming tokens and announce the finished reply once instead.
- With reduced motion, "Jump to latest" scrolls instantly.

Related: [message-bubble](message-bubble.md), [prompt-input](prompt-input.md), [streaming-text](streaming-text.md)

# Error Summary

Lists a form’s errors after a failed submit, with a link to each field. useFormErrors wires the fields to their messages.

- Package: `@nexub/patterns` · Category: Forms · Status: beta
- Import: `import { ErrorSummary } from '@nexub/patterns';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/error-summary

## When to use

- Forms validated on submit, especially long ones where some errors are off screen.
- Alongside inline messages, never instead of them.

## When not to use

- Live validation while typing: pass a new array per submit, not per keystroke, or the summary steals focus.
- A single field: the inline message is enough.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `errors` (required) | `{ id: string; message: string }[]` |  | One entry per invalid field; `id` is the field’s DOM id. Renders nothing when empty. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | `'There is a problem'` | Heading; it also labels the summary. |
| `onFocusField` | `(id: string) => void` |  | Called after a link moves focus to its field. |
| `useFormErrors(map)` (required) | `Record<string, string \| null \| undefined \| false>` |  | Takes `{ fieldId: message }`. Falsy messages are skipped. |
| `→ errors` | `ErrorSummaryItem[]` |  | The list for `ErrorSummary`. Stable for the same map object. |
| `→ fieldProps(id)` | `function` |  | Spread on the input: `id`, plus `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby="${id}-error"` when it has an error. |
| `→ errorProps(id)` | `function` |  | Spread on the inline message: `id="${id}-error"`, the same id FormField.Error uses. |

## Example: Validate on submit

Submit empty to see the summary. A new map per submit moves focus to the summary; links jump to each field.

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { type FormErrorMap, useFormErrors, ErrorSummary } from '@nexub/patterns';
import { Label, Input, FormError, Button } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = React.useState<FormErrorMap>({});
  const { errors, fieldProps, errorProps } = useFormErrors(submitted);
  const submit = (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const data = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    setSubmitted({
      'es-name': String(data.get('name')).trim() ? undefined : 'Enter your name',
      'es-email': /^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(String(data.get('email'))) ? undefined : 'Enter an email address, like name@example.com',
    });
  };
  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-3 items-stretch w-[340px]">
      <ErrorSummary errors={errors} />
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 items-stretch">
        <Label htmlFor="es-name">Name</Label>
        <Input name="name" {...fieldProps('es-name')} invalid={Boolean(submitted['es-name'])} />
        {submitted['es-name'] && <FormError {...errorProps('es-name')}>{submitted['es-name']}</FormError>}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 items-stretch">
        <Label htmlFor="es-email">Email</Label>
        <Input name="email" type="email" {...fieldProps('es-email')} invalid={Boolean(submitted['es-email'])} />
        {submitted['es-email'] && <FormError {...errorProps('es-email')}>{submitted['es-email']}</FormError>}
      </div>
      <Button type="submit">Create account</Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- Roles: alert
- Takes focus whenever it receives a new, non-empty `errors` array, so screen readers read it and keyboard users start from it.
- Each link scrolls its field into view and focuses it.
- An `alert` labelled by its heading. Fields get `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby` pointing at their inline message.

Related: [form-field](form-field.md), [input](input.md), [alert](alert.md)

# FeatureSplit

# FilterBar

Search + filter toolbar pattern for data-heavy list or table views.

- Package: `@nexub/patterns` · Category: Data · Status: stable
- Import: `import { FilterBar } from '@nexub/patterns';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/filter-bar

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `string` | `'Search…'` | Placeholder text for the search input. |
| `searchValue` | `string` |  | Controlled search value. |
| `onSearch` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Callback when search value changes. |
| `searchLabel` | `string` | `'Search'` | Accessible name of the search field (5.1). Defaults to the localised `search` message. |
| `filters` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Filter controls rendered to the right of search. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Action buttons (e.g. "Export") rendered on the far right. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-[480px]">
      <FilterBar
        searchPlaceholder="Search users…"
        filters={
          <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap items-center justify-center">
            <Badge tone="neutral">Status: All</Badge>
            <Badge tone="neutral">Plan: All</Badge>
          </div>
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Hero

The page hero: ambient backdrop, eyebrow, display headline (the page's one h1), lead, actions and a visual. Server component.

- Package: `@nexub/marketing` · Category: Marketing · Status: beta
- Import: `import { Hero } from '@nexub/marketing';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/hero

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (required) | `React.ReactNode` |  | The headline, rendered as the h1. |
| `eyebrow` | `React.ReactNode` |  | A string becomes a gradient EyebrowChip. |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  | The lead paragraph. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  | One `Button variant="hero"` and one outlined button, usually. |
| `visual` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Product shot or illustration. Beside the text on wide screens with `align="start"`. |
| `align` | `'center' \| 'start'` | `'center'` | Text alignment and layout. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { Button } from '@nexub/react';
import { Hero } from '@nexub/marketing';
import { ArrowRight } from '@nexub/icons';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div data-mode="marketing" className="w-full">
      <Hero
        eyebrow="Now in Vietnam"
        title="Run your whole company in one place"
        description="Payroll, bookkeeping and compliance for growing teams across Southeast Asia and India."
        actions={
          <>
            <Button variant="hero" size="lg" trailingIcon={<ArrowRight size={16} />}>Start free</Button>
            <Button variant="outlined" size="lg">Book a demo</Button>
          </>
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# HowItWorks

Numbered steps in an ordered list. Server component.

- Package: `@nexub/marketing` · Category: Marketing · Status: beta
- Import: `import { HowItWorks } from '@nexub/marketing';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/how-it-works

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` (required) | `{ title, description, icon? }[]` |  | The steps; the number shows unless an icon is given. |
| `header` | `React.ReactNode` |  | A SectionHeader, usually. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { HowItWorks, SectionHeader } from '@nexub/marketing';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div data-mode="marketing" className="w-full">
      <HowItWorks
        header={<SectionHeader title="Up and running in a day" />}
        steps={[
          { title: 'Create your account', description: 'Sign up with your company details.' },
          { title: 'Invite your team', description: 'Add people and their bank details.' },
          { title: 'Run your first payroll', description: 'Review, approve and pay.' },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# InfoList

Key–value list for displaying structured metadata or details.

- Package: `@nexub/patterns` · Category: Data · Status: stable
- Import: `import { InfoList } from '@nexub/patterns';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/info-list

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | The key label. |
| `value` (required) | `React.ReactNode` |  | The displayed value. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { InfoList } from '@nexub/patterns';
import { Badge } from '@nexub/react';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-[280px]">
      <InfoList.Root>
        <InfoList.Item label="Plan" value="Pro" />
        <InfoList.Item label="Seats" value="12 / 50" />
        <InfoList.Item label="Renewal" value="Jan 15, 2026" />
        <InfoList.Item label="Status" value={<Badge tone="success" size="sm">Active</Badge>} />
      </InfoList.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# List Detail

The list-detail layout: side by side at 720px+ of its own width (a container query), one pane at a time below.

- Package: `@nexub/patterns` · Category: Layout · Status: beta
- Import: `import { ListDetail } from '@nexub/patterns';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/list-detail

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list / detail` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The two panes. |
| `showDetail` | `boolean` | `false` | When narrow, show the detail instead of the list (set it on selection). |
| `onBack` | `() => void` |  | Back button, shown only when narrow. |
| `listWidth` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Fixed list width when both panes show (288 / 320 / 400px). |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { ListDetail } from '@nexub/patterns';

export default function Example() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState<number | null>(0);
  const items = ['Quarterly report', 'Design review', 'Invoice #4821'];
  return (
    <div className="w-full h-[240px] border border-[var(--color-outline-variant)] rounded-[16px] overflow-hidden">
      <ListDetail
        showDetail={selected !== null}
        onBack={() => setSelected(null)}
        list={
          <ul className="p-2 m-0 list-none">
            {items.map((m, i) => (
              <li key={m}>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setSelected(i)} className="nx-state-layer relative w-full rounded-shape-container px-3 py-2 text-left text-body-sm">
                  {m}
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        }
        detail={<div className="text-title-md p-5">{selected === null ? 'Nothing selected' : items[selected]}</div>}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# LogoStrip

A row of customer logos under the hero, scrolling sideways (paused on hover and focus) or wrapped. Server component.

- Package: `@nexub/marketing` · Category: Marketing · Status: beta
- Import: `import { LogoStrip } from '@nexub/marketing';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/logo-strip

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  | e.g. "Trusted by 2,000+ teams". |
| `scroll` | `boolean` | `true` | Scroll the logos (marketing mode only); off gives a wrapped row. |
| `children` (required) | `React.ReactNode` |  | The logos. Give each its alt text. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { LogoStrip } from '@nexub/marketing';

const customers = ['Acme', 'Globex', 'Initech', 'Umbrella', 'Hooli', 'Vandelay'];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div data-mode="marketing" className="w-full">
      <LogoStrip label="Trusted by 2,000+ teams">
        {customers.map((name) => (
          <span key={name} className="text-title-lg text-[var(--color-on-surface-muted)]">{name}</span>
        ))}
      </LogoStrip>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# MarketingFooter

The site footer: a tools strip, the logo, link columns and the legal line. Server component.

- Package: `@nexub/marketing` · Category: Marketing · Status: beta
- Import: `import { MarketingFooter } from '@nexub/marketing';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/marketing-footer

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` (required) | `{ title, links: { label, href }[] }[]` |  | Link columns, each a labelled nav. |
| `logo` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Logo. |
| `tagline` | `React.ReactNode` |  | A line under the logo. |
| `tools` | `React.ReactNode[]` |  | Tools or integrations, scrolling in a strip. |
| `toolsLabel` | `string` | `'Works with'` | Label of the tools strip. |
| `bottom` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Copyright and legal links. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { Logo } from '@nexub/react';
import { MarketingFooter } from '@nexub/marketing';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div data-mode="marketing" className="w-full">
      <MarketingFooter
        logo={<Logo size="sm" />}
        tagline="The operating system for growing companies."
        tools={['Slack', 'Xero', 'Google Workspace', 'Stripe', 'QuickBooks', 'WhatsApp']}
        columns={[
          { title: 'Products', links: [{ label: 'Payub', href: '#payub' }, { label: 'Bookub', href: '#bookub' }, { label: 'Leap', href: '#leap' }] },
          { title: 'Company', links: [{ label: 'About', href: '#about' }, { label: 'Careers', href: '#careers' }] },
          { title: 'Resources', links: [{ label: 'Help centre', href: '#help' }, { label: 'Status', href: '#status' }] },
        ]}
        bottom="© 2026 Nexub Pte. Ltd., Singapore"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# MarketingNav

The site header: logo, links with mega-menus, a country switcher and actions. Below `lg` the links move into a side sheet.

- Package: `@nexub/marketing` · Category: Marketing · Status: beta
- Import: `import { MarketingNav } from '@nexub/marketing';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/marketing-nav

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `logo` (required) | `React.ReactNode` |  | Logo, wrapped in a link to `logoHref`. |
| `items` (required) | `MarketingNavItem[]` |  | Links; an item with `items` opens a mega-menu of links with descriptions. |
| `countries` | `MarketingCountry[]` |  | Country sites: `{ code, label, href }`. The switcher shows when there are two or more. |
| `country` | `string` |  | Current country code. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Sign in / Get started buttons. |
| `logoHref` | `string` | `'/'` | Where the logo links. |
| `menuLabel` | `string` | `'Open menu'` | Accessible name of the mobile menu button. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { Button, Logo } from '@nexub/react';
import { MarketingNav } from '@nexub/marketing';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div data-mode="marketing" className="w-full">
      <MarketingNav
        logo={<Logo size="sm" />}
        items={[
          {
            label: 'Products',
            items: [
              { label: 'Payub', href: '#payub', description: 'Payroll and HR' },
              { label: 'Bookub', href: '#bookub', description: 'Bookkeeping' },
              { label: 'Leap', href: '#leap', description: 'Company formation' },
              { label: 'Founderub', href: '#founderub', description: 'Founder tools' },
            ],
          },
          { label: 'Pricing', href: '#pricing' },
          { label: 'Customers', href: '#customers' },
        ]}
        countries={[
          { code: 'SG', label: 'Singapore', href: '#sg' },
          { code: 'IN', label: 'India', href: '#in' },
          { code: 'ID', label: 'Indonesia', href: '#id' },
          { code: 'MY', label: 'Malaysia', href: '#my' },
          { code: 'VN', label: 'Vietnam', href: '#vn' },
        ]}
        country="SG"
        actions={
          <>
            <Button variant="text" size="sm" asChild><a href="#signin">Sign in</a></Button>
            <Button variant="filled" size="sm" asChild><a href="#start">Get started</a></Button>
          </>
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# NotificationItem

Single notification row for notification panels or dropdowns.

- Package: `@nexub/patterns` · Category: Feedback · Status: stable
- Import: `import { NotificationItem } from '@nexub/patterns';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/notification-item

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (required) | `string` |  | Notification title. |
| `description` | `string` |  | Supporting text. |
| `timestamp` | `string` |  | Relative time string. |
| `unread` | `boolean` | `false` | Applies unread indicator styling. |
| `avatar` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Avatar for the notification actor. |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  | Click handler for the item. |

## Example: Default

```tsx

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-[340px]">
      <NotificationItem title="New team member" description="Sarah joined your workspace." timestamp="2 min ago" read={false} />
      <NotificationItem title="Invoice paid" description="Invoice #1042 was paid successfully." timestamp="1 hr ago" read />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# PlanCard

Pricing plan card with feature checklist, badge, and CTA button.

- Package: `@nexub/patterns` · Category: Marketing · Status: stable
- Import: `import { PlanCard } from '@nexub/patterns';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/plan-card

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` (required) | `string` |  | Plan name (e.g. "Pro"). |
| `price` (required) | `string` |  | Price string (e.g. "$49/mo"). |
| `description` | `string` |  | Short plan description. |
| `features` | `string[]` |  | List of included features. |
| `highlighted` | `boolean` | `false` | Applies brand accent styling for recommended plans. |
| `badge` | `string` |  | Label for the plan badge (e.g. "Most Popular"). |
| `ctaLabel` | `string` | `'Get started'` | CTA button label. |
| `onCta` | `() => void` |  | CTA button click handler. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { PlanCard } from '@nexub/patterns';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-[280px]">
      <PlanCard
        name="Pro"
        price="$49"
        period="/ month"
        description="For growing teams that need more power."
        features={['Unlimited seats', 'Advanced analytics', 'Priority support']}
        cta="Get started"
        onSelect={() => {}}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# PricingTable

Plans side by side with a monthly / yearly switch, built on PlanCard and SegmentedControl. Client component.

- Package: `@nexub/marketing` · Category: Marketing · Status: beta
- Import: `import { PricingTable } from '@nexub/marketing';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/pricing-table

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plans` (required) | `PricingPlan[]` |  | Each plan: `name`, `price: { monthly, yearly }` per month, `features`, `cta`, and `href` or `onSelect`; `highlighted` and `badge` optional. |
| `currency` (required) | `string` |  | ISO 4217 code. |
| `locale` | `string` |  | BCP 47 locale for the prices. |
| `defaultPeriod` | `'monthly' \| 'yearly'` | `'monthly'` | Billing period shown first. |
| `periodLabels` | `Record<BillingPeriod, string>` |  | Labels of the switch. |
| `perMonthLabel` | `string` | `'/month'` | Shown after each price. |
| `header` | `React.ReactNode` |  | A SectionHeader, usually. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { PricingTable, SectionHeader } from '@nexub/marketing';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div data-mode="marketing" className="w-full">
      <PricingTable
        header={<SectionHeader title="Simple pricing" description="Save two months with yearly billing." />}
        currency="SGD"
        locale="en-SG"
        plans={[
          { name: 'Starter', price: { monthly: 29, yearly: 24 }, features: ['Up to 10 people', 'Payroll', 'Email support'], cta: 'Start free', href: '#starter' },
          { name: 'Growth', price: { monthly: 79, yearly: 66 }, features: ['Up to 100 people', 'Payroll and HR', 'Bookkeeping'], cta: 'Start free', href: '#growth', highlighted: true, badge: 'Most popular' },
          { name: 'Scale', price: { monthly: 199, yearly: 166 }, features: ['Unlimited people', 'All products', 'Dedicated manager'], cta: 'Talk to sales', href: '#scale' },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# ProductGrid

Product cards in a grid; each card is one link with the product's accent. Server component.

- Package: `@nexub/marketing` · Category: Marketing · Status: beta
- Import: `import { ProductGrid } from '@nexub/marketing';`
- Docs: https://nexub-ds-docs.pages.dev/patterns/product-grid

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `React.ReactNode` |  | ProductGrid: a SectionHeader, usually. |
| `name` (required) | `string` |  | ProductCard: product name, the card's link text. |
| `description` (required) | `React.ReactNode` |  | ProductCard: one line on what it does. |
| `href` (required) | `string` |  | ProductCard: the product page. |
| `icon` | `React.ReactNode` |  | ProductCard: the product mark. |
| `accent` | `'leap' \| 'bookub' \| 'payub' \| 'founderub'` |  | ProductCard: coloured top edge and tint in marketing mode. |
| `linkLabel` | `string` | `'Learn more'` | ProductCard: the visual link cue. |

## Example: Default

```tsx
import { BookubMark, FounderubMark, LeapMark, PayubMark } from '@nexub/icons';
import { ProductCard, ProductGrid, SectionHeader } from '@nexub/marketing';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div data-mode="marketing" className="w-full">
      <ProductGrid header={<SectionHeader eyebrow="Platform" title="One account, four products" />}>
        <ProductCard name="Leap" description="Incorporate and stay compliant." href="#leap" accent="leap" icon={<LeapMark size={24} />} />
        <ProductCard name="Bookub" description="Bookkeeping that closes itself." href="#bookub" accent="bookub" icon={<BookubMark size={24} />} />
        <ProductCard name="Payub" description="Payroll and HR in one place." href="#payub" accent="payub" icon={<PayubMark size={24} />} />
        <ProductCard name="Founderub" description="Cap table and fundraising." href="#founderub" accent="founderub" icon={<FounderubMark size={24} />} />
      </ProductGrid>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Eyebrow, headline and lead that open a section. Server component.

```tsx
      <SectionHeader
        eyebrow="Platform"
        title="Everything your company needs"
        description="Four products on one account, one login and one bill."
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```
